hook.line: Somebody just leaked an HTML file on GitHub with free access to 50+ AI tools.
hook.visual: Top half: animated dark GitHub promo with big '50+ ai tools IN ONE PLACE' title; bottom half: presenter at desk with mic, small captions at the seam.

beats.what: Split screen opens on the '50+ AI tools in one place' title over a GitHub promo animation, 'somebody just leaked'
Fast cuts in the top half: GitHub logo, then each named model's logo (Claude asterisk) as he lists them
Cut to the repo README's feature list while he says 'they're calling it God mode'
'Here's how it works' over the GitHub file list
Zoom punch into the God Mode app screen as he describes running it locally
Cuts through the app's settings: privacy toggle shows 'no login, no subscription'
Red arrow points at the 'race all 5' combo mode for the head-to-head feature
Layout drops to full-frame presenter for the CTA
Big 'GOD MODE' text over his chest, the comment keyword

why_it_works: 'Leaked' plus 'free' in the first three seconds frames it as insider news the viewer might miss
The top half changes on every noun he says (a cut about every 1.5 s) while his face stays steady below
Switching to full frame for the CTA marks the ending, and the keyword appears as big text
The comment-keyword gate ('comment God Mode') drove 4,432 comments, far above the other metrics' ratio
weaknesses: Captions are tiny and sit on the seam between halves, easy to miss
Calling a public repo 'leaked' oversells it; risky for trust
The God Mode screens are shown too briefly to read what they do
for_robert: Swap the full-frame layout for the CTA: after a split-screen body, drop to Robert full frame and pop the comment keyword as a big word, with Fred pointing at it.
